item.title: Truckers, bus drivers will be required to take commercial driver's license tests in English
item.description: All truckers and bus drivers will have to take their commercial driver’s license tests in English as the Trump administration expands its aggressive campaign to improve safety in the industry and get unqualified drivers off the road.

item.title: Thousands lost power as high winds rip through Northeast Ohio
item.description: Wind gusts up to 40 mph are causing outages across Northeast Ohio.

item.title: Trump says he’ll sign executive order to enact 10% global tariff
item.description: The president said on social media Friday night that he had signed an executive order enabling him to bypass Congress and impose a 10% tax on imports from around the world.

item.title: Crews demolishing part of Lakeside High School: 'A gut punch'
item.description: It was a tough day for many people in the community as demolition crews continued tearing down part of Lakeside High School in the Ashtabula Area City School District on Friday.

item.title: Fish Fry Guide 2026: Where to go in NE Ohio
item.description: With the Christian tradition of Lent upon us, it’s time to start making the hard choices of which fish fries you’ll take in on Fridays this season.

item.title: Former 'Jersey Shore' star Snooki reveals cancer diagnosis
item.description: Nicole “Snooki” Polizzi said Friday that she has cervical cancer.

item.title: Cavaliers beat Hornets 118-113 for 7th straight victory
item.description: Donovan Mitchell scored 13 of his 32 points in the fourth quarter and the streaking Cleveland Cavaliers held off the Charlotte Hornets 118-113 on Friday night for their seventh straight victory and 12th win in 13 games.

item.title: NASA targets March for 1st moon mission by Artemis astronauts after fueling test success
item.description: NASA aims to send astronauts to the moon in March after acing the latest rocket fueling test.

item.title: Governor signs law that could help get justice for fallen officer
item.description: The governor Friday evening signed into a law a new bill to give prosecutors more time to get suspects in the most serious cases mentally fit for trial.

item.title: Weekend forecast: Temps dropping, winter storm system brings snow
item.description: Overnight, skies are cloudy still but winds are backing off. It will still be breezy but not as gusty. Temperatures are falling closer to seasonable, on either side of 30 degrees.
